info.name: Auto CRM API - E2E
info.description: End-to-end story for the Auto CRM API. Run it against an EMPTY database (./e2e/run.sh does this): set up the super admin, create two admins, do the CRM work as the first admin, and check that the super admin is read-only and that the second admin cannot see the first admin's records.

exec: pm.test("status ok", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body).to.eql({status: "ok"}); });

item.name: 02 Auth
item.description: Set up the super admin, create two admins with POST /users, then log in as each.

item.name: Setup is needed on a new install

exec: pm.test("super admin", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.role).to.eql("admin"); pm.expect(body.is_super_admin).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("email is stored lowercase", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.email).to.eql(pm.environment.get("superEmail")); });
pm.test("bearer token returned", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.token_type).to.eql("bearer"); pm.expect(body.access_token).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test("a plain admin", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.role).to.eql("admin"); pm.expect(body.is_super_admin).to.eql(false); pm.expect(body.is_active).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("detail is A user with this email already exists", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("A user with this email already exists"));

item.name: 03 Users
item.description: Only the super admin lists everyone, creates admins and switches them on or off.

item.name: List users (super admin sees every admin)

exec: pm.test("both admins, no super admin", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.total).to.eql(2); pm.expect(body.items.map(u => u.email).sort()).to.eql([pm.environment.get("adminEmail"), pm.environment.get("admin2Email")].sort()); pm.expect(body.items.some(u => u.is_super_admin)).to.eql(false); });

item.name: 06 Pipeline
item.description: The five stages seeded by the migrations. Only the super admin changes them.

exec: pm.test("ordered default stages", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.map(s => s.name)).to.eql(["Qualification", "Proposal", "Negotiation", "Won", "Lost"]); });

pm.collectionVariables.set("stageQualification", byName["Qualification"].id); pm.collectionVariables.set("stageProposal", byName["Proposal"].id); pm.collectionVariables.set("stageNegotiation", byName["Negotiation"].id); pm.collectionVariables.set("stageWon", byName["Won"].id); pm.collectionVariables.set("stageLost", byName["Lost"].id);

pm.test("first stage, USD, numeric value", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.stage.name).to.eql("Qualification"); pm.expect(body.currency).to.eql("USD"); pm.expect(body.value).to.eql(15000.5); });
pm.test("open deal has no closed_at", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.closed_at).to.eql(null); });
pm.test("currency upper-cased", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.currency).to.eql("EUR"); pm.expect(body.stage.name).to.eql("Proposal"); });
pm.test("detail is Pipeline stage not found", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("Pipeline stage not found"));

item.name: Move deal to Won sets closed_at

exec: pm.test("won and closed", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.stage.is_won).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.closed_at).to.be.a('string'); });

item.name: Move deal back to Negotiation clears closed_at

exec: pm.test("open again", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.stage.name).to.eql("Negotiation"); pm.expect(body.closed_at).to.eql(null); });

pm.test("lost and closed", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.title).to.eql("Acme support (lost)"); pm.expect(body.stage.is_lost).to.eql(true); pm.expect(body.closed_at).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test("company nested", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.company.name).to.eql("Acme Inc"); });
pm.test("only the won deal", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.items.map(d => d.id)).to.eql([pm.collectionVariables.get("pilotDealId")]); });
pm.test("two Acme deals", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.total).to.eql(2); });
pm.test("finds the expansion", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.items.map(d => d.title)).to.eql(["Globex expansion"]); });

item.name: 10 Dashboard
item.description: Numbers match what this run created. Admins see only their own; the super admin sees all.

exec: pm.test("open pipeline = Globex expansion only", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.open_pipeline_value).to.eql(8000); });
pm.test("won this month = Acme pilot", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.won_this_month_value).to.eql(15000.5); });
pm.test("two new leads", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.new_leads_this_month).to.eql(2); });
pm.test("one overdue task", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.overdue_tasks).to.eql(1); });
pm.test("every stage listed", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.pipeline_by_stage.length).to.eql(5); });

pm.test("per stage counts and totals", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); const s = Object.fromEntries(body.pipeline_by_stage.map(r => [r.stage_name, r])); pm.expect(s.Qualification.deal_count).to.eql(0); pm.expect(s.Proposal.total_value).to.eql(8000); pm.expect(s.Won.total_value).to.eql(15000.5); pm.expect(s.Lost.deal_count).to.eql(1); });
pm.test("admin's open tasks", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.my_tasks.map(t => t.title).sort()).to.eql(["Prepare contract", "Schedule demo"]); });

item.name: Summary (second admin sees nothing of the first)

exec: pm.test("empty dashboard", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.open_pipeline_value).to.eql(0); pm.expect(body.won_this_month_value).to.eql(0); pm.expect(body.new_leads_this_month).to.eql(0); pm.expect(body.overdue_tasks).to.eql(0); pm.expect(body.my_tasks).to.eql([]); pm.expect(body.recent_activities).to.eql([]); });
pm.test("leaderboard is only me", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.team.map(m => m.user.full_name)).to.eql(["Max Admin"]); });

pm.test("totals cover the first admin", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.open_pipeline_value).to.eql(8000); pm.expect(body.won_this_month_value).to.eql(15000.5); pm.expect(body.new_leads_this_month).to.eql(2); });
pm.test("leaderboard lists both admins", () => { const body = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(body.team.map(m => m.user.full_name).sort()).to.eql(["Ada Admin", "Max Admin"]); });
